verdict.rationale: Docusaurus is a static site generator whose content is plain MDX files, so bulk operations are a fair axis. The only evidence is CLI commands that act on the whole content set at once: the versioning CLI snapshots the entire docs directory into a new version, and the build turns all docs into static files in one run. missing for 10: any documented bulk edit, move, retag or delete across many docs or posts, a scriptable or programmatic bulk API for agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
